title: The North Shore Beach Cabana
specs: Anyone born after 1988 must pass the Boater Safety Course prior to operating a vessel
Scenic cruises accommodate 4-16 guests per boat; guests may be placed with other groups
includes: Life jackets, safety instructions, and a lake map included with pontoon boat rentals
gap: Age minimum for rentals and cruises not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy scenic lake cruises, seasonal kayak and paddleboard rentals, beachside refreshments, and easy access to the water surrounded by Blue Ridge Mountain views. The Cabana is open to members and lodging guests only. It offers pontoon boat rentals, kayak rentals, and a private beach reserved for community members and lodging guests.
extraNote: All cruises require a minimum of 4 passengers to depart · Scenic cruise reservations are non-refundable · For any changes to your reservation, contact the North Shore Beach Cabana at least 24 hours prior · Cancellations within 24 hours of the reservation are non-refundable · No glass or hard liquor permitted on pontoon boats · North Shore Beach Cabana at 172 Mountains Blvd, Lake Lure, NC 28746 · Memorial Day Weekend through the end of October
